tests.name: jev admin stats (gate_health, loops) still auth-gated

tests.reason: The admin stats body needs an exafy_admin session, and the skip rows are written by Dev Autopilot and BackOffice runs that a read-only staging probe must not cause (the Dev Autopilot kill switch is also armed). Skip rows, dedupe, mode handling, lean scoring, the 48 h silent flag and the endpoint's new fields are proven by these suites; the migration is proven on a local Postgres by scripts/ci/test-vtid-05012-jev-gate-observability.sh and verified read-only on the database after apply.
